entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 5.0.0.344 for Android
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 5.0.0.344 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Adds support for remotely configuring Zscaler Client Connector features, including administrator-set overrides, through mobile device management (MDM).
Improves battery and CPU performance on Android devices by eliminating unnecessary background activity and pausing Digital Experience (ZDX) after 10 minutes of inactivity.
Adds support for the Japanese language based on localization settings on the device.
Updates Zscaler Client Connector to exclude compromised TLS intermediate certificates associated with digital certificate provider eMudhra when loading root certificates. To learn more, see the trust post.

entries.category: Release Available: Client Connector 5.0 for iOS
entries.title: Zscaler Client Connector 5.0 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Supports Wi-Fi Name (SSID) as a condition for trusted network criteria.
Modernizes Zscaler Client Connector to provide users with clear status and actionable, natural-language guidance, while keeping technical details within easy reach if they need to engage Zscaler Support.
Adds support to block LAN access via Zscaler Tunnel (Z-Tunnel) on Zscaler Client Connector using an mobile device management (MDM)-delivered custom VPN profile.
Adds support for French and German languages based on localization settings on the device.
Supports Disaster Recovery for Private Access and Internet & SaaS for Authentication Service.
Improves performance for customers with a large number of hosted-based Private Access applications.
Optimizes the Zscaler Client Connector iOS battery and resource usage.
Optimizes iOS packet tunnel network settings to reduce unnecessary reconfiguration and improve network stability, lowering the likelihood of user-visible interruptions during network changes.
Supports automatic Private Access certificate renewal before the certificate expires.
Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.
Supports detection of unauthorized device modifications on iOS devices.
Supports configuring Zscaler Client Connector to use the system DNS to resolve DNS queries by enabling the Prioritize System DNS option in App Profiles.
Supports delaying per-app VPN connection until Private Access configuration and connection are established, preventing app connection timeout messages.
Adds native end-to-end IPv6 from IPv6-only iOS devices to Internet & SaaS and Private Access when Enable IPv6 resolution for Zscaler Domains is selected in Platform Settings.
Supports displaying a customizable notification to end users who are blocked from a Private Access app due to a failed device posture.
Adds support for the collection of Health Metrics on devices to allow for diagnostics and to proactively identify issues.
Enables the ability to base alternative cloud name detection on the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS location instead of the Zscaler Client Connector location and to have an alternative cloud name per Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS.
Obfuscates MDM payloads and device posture information in logs when a device posture check fails.
Zscaler Client Connector ignores the setting in App Profiles to block Apple Private Relay by default.

entries.title: Enhancements for End User Isolation Experience
entries.text:
Enhancements have been made to several features of the end user isolation experience. Depending on your isolation profile settings, you can explore the following features and functionalities in the Zero Trust Mode menu during an isolated session:
Clipboard: Use clipboard functions (e.g., copy and paste) and view notifications about clipboard restrictions. To learn more, see Using Clipboard in Isolation.
Translate: Translate the entire web page or selected text from the web page into your preferred language. To learn more, see Understanding Language Translate for Isolation.
Find: Search text within the web page.
Troubleshoot: View network latency and export isolation session logs. To learn more, see Accessing Network Latency in Isolation.
To learn more, see Using the Zero Trust Mode Menu in Native Browser Experience.

entries.title: Manager Software Updates
entries.text:
A recommended update was released that includes updated App Connector and Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.x and 9.x, and Private Cloud Controller and Network Connector RPM packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.x.
You can download the Manager software for App Connectors, Private Service Edges, Private Cloud Controllers, or Network Connectors from our repository. The Manager software version is 26.59.1.
To learn more, see Understanding the Manager Software.

entries.title: Wildcard Support for Network Segments
entries.text:
You can define Network segments in VPN (for Legacy Apps) using wildcard entries (e.g., *.domain.com). This streamlines configuration for environments with FQDNs.
This feature is only supported on Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for Windows.
To learn more, see Configuring Network Segments.

entries.title: Entitlement Orchestration for Private Applications
entries.text:
Private Access (ZPA) supports Entitlement Orchestration, enabling Just-in-Time (JIT) access to private applications. This workflow allows an external, customer-managed orchestration client or workflow to dynamically grant and revoke user access by calling Private Access APIs.
By programmatically updating user memberships in Authentication Service local user groups referenced by Private Access access policies, you can provision temporary access without modifying your core Private Access access policies or application segments. This is ideal for time-bound or event-driven scenarios, such as contractor onboarding, break-glass administration, and temporary project assignments.
The Entitlement Orchestration workflow includes the following features:
Drives the request, approval, and API-based provisioning of access.
Houses the temporary group memberships updated via API.
Defines the private applications secure access is granted to.
Controls access permissions based on Authentication Service local user group criteria.
To learn more, see Entitlement Orchestration for Private Access.

entries.category: Release Available: ZDX Module 4.9 for Windows
entries.title: ZDX Module 4.9.0.51 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Adds Extranet Application Support to Zscaler Client Connector and Digital Experience (ZDX) Cloud Path.
Adds support for admin to configure ZDX client routing preferences for direct connections to an external forward proxy.
Adds support for a control in the Remediation Settings to check for the Windows PowerShell Execution Policy prior to running diagnostic and remediation scripts on managed endpoints.
Adds Traceroute support with Zscaler Client Connector's Multi-Connect SME feature, enabling Cloud Path visualization and hop-by-hop latency metrics.
Discontinues support for 32-bit (x86) Windows clients in alignment with the Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 release.
Enhances security for Zscaler Client Connector and ZDX Module.
Increases TTL to 64 for resilient and strict probes to prevent premature Cloud Path probe drop-offs when customers have 30+ network hops.

entries.category: Release Available: ZDX Module 5.0.0 for iOS
entries.title: ZDX Module 5.0.0 Enhancements and Fixes
entries.text:
Adds support for ZDX Devices Events.
Improvements were made to the Zscaler Client Connector application to simplify the UX.
Adds fixes to improve battery optimization by stopping ZDX when a device is locked or a network is down, and also stopping probes when a device's battery is less than 15%.
